text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, a while after I've officially<n>become Zenno
Rob Roy's trainer...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well, thank you for today. See you<n>tomorrow for
another session.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly remembering, I pick up a<n>pile of papers
from my desk. It's a<n>summary of our training
schedule for<n>the days ahead.
choice_data_list: Would you read this when you have a chance?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, certainly! Thank you. I'll have it<n>memorized in
no time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(All those books on Trainer's desk...<n>They've got
slip-on covers, but<n>judging by their thickness, I'd
say<n>they're manuals for training.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I did notice Trainer yawning this<n>morning... These
plans must've taken<n>all night to prepare.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, uh, sorry! It's only, well...
choice_data_list: You can talk to me if something's troubling you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing! I'm fine, nothing to<n>worry about.
You caught me<n>pondering to myself, is all!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Oh no... I made Trainer worry!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(But... I suppose it's always been<n>that way. Trainer
is always watching<n>out for me, giving me the
encouragement I need.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Don't give uuup!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You're the protagonist, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You're the protagonist, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(It's almost a waste on someone like<n>me... Isn't
it?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (But... a person like that called me a<n>hero.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hehe... hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Well, someone looks happy. Did<n>something good
happen or what, Rob<n>Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-sorry. I just, well... I was<n>laughing because,
umm...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait! Let me guess. Hmmm...<n>Ah! I've got it!
You found a really<n>good book! It has to be that,
right?<n>Right?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Actually, it's even better...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And then Trainer asked me if<n>anything was wrong.
Isn't that the<n>kindest, most considerate thing?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And they're very studious as well.<n>Just today, they
were so professional<n>in our session and prepared
all these<n>training materials.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That really is great. I wish I<n>could find a
trainer like that!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So people like that really exist, huh?<n>Your trainer
sounds amazing! Like a<n>character straight out of a
novel!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer really is... like a character from<n>a book.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I mean, I've never met anyone sokind, hardworking, and honest... Likea true hero, who would surely neverstray from their convictions.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Did I just say... they'd "surely" never<n>stray?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I really do think Trainer is a person<n>like that, but...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, I have to wonder... am I just<n>imagining it?
But... eurgh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy stares out the<n>window, lost in
thought. She tries and<n>tries but never reaches an
answer.
